## Summary

The Lynch (2011) lower-bound argument predicts an inverse relationship between
per-site mutation rate and effective population size. Selection pushes mutation
rates down only until further improvements yield fitness gains too small to
overcome drift. In eukaryotes the observed per-generation mutation rate has
been reported to scale roughly as Ne^-0.6, though possibly as steeply as Ne^-1.
